name: Microsoft Agent 365 Trigger
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Microsoft Agent 365 Trigger node to receive messages from Microsoft Agent 365 and respond with AI-powered agent capabilities. This node allows n8n to act as the backend for your Agent 365 agents

parameters.name: Enable Microsoft Work IQ Tools for A365

options: All: Enable all available Microsoft MCP tools
Selected: Choose specific tools from the list:

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: Connect an output parser on the canvas to specify the output format you require

parameters.name: fallbackNotice

parameters.name: useMcpTools
parameters.displayName: Enable Microsoft Work IQ Tools for A365
